name: Light Air Strike
stats: Support=Offensive Aerospace; TN=5; Groups=2; Type=N/A
effect: Declare in the Ranged Attack Phase. Hit: 2 groups of 5 on the target, 12 hits the rear. Miss: no effect.
notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. Enemy air cover can cancel it. BV 200.

name: Light Bombing
stats: Support=Offensive Aerospace; TN=5; Groups=3; Type=AE; Scatter=1D6
effect: Hit: 3 AE groups in the target hex. Miss: scatters 1 hex per point missed; hits whatever is there. Buildings: all inside take full damage.
notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. Enemy air cover can cancel it. BV 260.

name: Heavy Bombing
stats: Support=Offensive Aerospace; TN=7; Groups=6; Type=AE; Scatter=1D6

name: Strafing
stats: Support=Offensive Aerospace; TN=7; Groups=3; Type=DE; Area=Up to 5 hexes in a line
effect: Pick up to 5 hexes in a straight line. Roll for every unit there, friend or foe; each hit takes 3 groups.
notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. Enemy air cover can cancel it. BV 440.

name: Bluff
stats: Support=Offensive Aerospace; Not an attack
effect: Played face down like an air attack. When revealed nothing happens; discard it. Any air cover spent on it is wasted.
notes: Only with optional Hidden Aerospace Strikes. One per side per game. Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. BV 100.

name: Light Air Cover
stats: Support=Defensive Aerospace; Not an attack; Light Air Strike=4; Light Bombing=4; Heavy Air Strike=9; Strafing=11; Heavy Bombing=11
effect: After enemy air attacks are declared, assign to one and roll. Meet the number for that attack type and it's cancelled.
notes: Several can go on one attack or be split; assign all before rolling. Low Visibility +1. Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. BV 100.

name: Arrow IV
stats: Support=Artillery; TN=8; Groups=4/2; Type=AE; Radius=1; Scatter=1D6
effect: Write the target hex now; it lands next turn. Target hex takes the first number, adjacent hexes the second. Miss: scatters.
notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Low Visibility +1; a spotter with LOS both turns -2. Up to 5 pre-designated hexes per mapsheet, written before deployment: firing at one auto-hits. BV 320.
